title: Ernst Steinitz: Modern LaTeX Transcriptions and English Translation Drafts
version: 2026-06-04 Steinitz author lane from corpus package 19
description:
Dedicated Ernst Steinitz author record for modern LaTeX transcriptions, English translation drafts, source witnesses, and QA artifacts. Current public readers cover selected work from 1894, 1897, 1899, 1901, 1905, 1910, and 1911, with a source-only slice for the 1912 Rectangular Systems II paper included as next-pass material.

Status at a glance. The 1894 dissertation material is complete in paired German and English working readers. The 1897, 1899, 1901, 1905, 1910, and 1911 readers are delivered as paired German and English working files. The 1912 Rectangular Systems II item remains source-only in this release. The ZIP artifact preserves TeX, TXT, source scans/source PDFs, render checks, checksums, and package notes.

Latest update. Promotes corpus package 19: adds complete German and English working readers for the 1905 one-sided-polyhedron paper, retains the 1912 Rectangular Systems II source slice, and refreshes the source/witness ZIP.
notes: Corpus package 19 adds complete German and English working readers for the 1905 one-sided-polyhedron paper, keeps the 1912 Rectangular Systems II source slice as source-only next-pass material, and refreshes the source/witness ZIP.
